subject: Case B2 — Confirmed out-of-scope issuer, signature valid (FG-TIDA/use-cases#27; per themes#42 review, former Case B split into B1/B2)

D1.source: signature replay on frozen vector T-B2a

D1.claim: Issuer lacks required scope for this credential profile and claim type
D1.source: authoritative scope registry consulted at verification time; issuer not listed for this profile (frozen vector T-B2b)

authority_basis.question: what makes the negative response authoritative for the relevant scope, time and federation relationships
authority_basis.authority_source: the scope registry designated as authoritative for this credential profile and claim type; its consultation is recorded as frozen vector T-B2b, so the input is reproducible without network access
authority_basis.scope_of_authority: issuer scope for this credential profile and claim type only; the registry response is evidence about that scope and about nothing else
authority_basis.time_basis: the consultation is fixed at the verification instant of the frozen vector; staleness of that response is exactly what rule R6 of a composition layer would have to assess
authority_basis.federation_basis: the input records one registry as the consulted source; which registry governs when several could apply, and how cross-federation answers are combined, is deliberately left for each implementation to declare — that declaration is part of what this case asks an implementer to state
authority_basis.residual_limit: the input supplies the basis as recorded evidence; it does not certify the registry itself — auditing the registry's own authority is out of scope for this case
